title: Loss-Based Active Learning for Neural Abstractive Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2608.25881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning abstractive summarization models requires high-quality annotated data. However, obtaining such corpora is expensive and time-consuming, as it requires human annotators to read and comprehend long documents to create accurate summaries. Active learning mitigates this issue by selecting only the most informative instances for annotation, allowing models to achieve competitive results with significantly fewer labels. However, the application of active learning to summarization remains under-explored, and existing studies often suffer from instability and significant computational bottlenecks. To overcome these challenges, we propose LOBSTER (LOss-BaSed acTivE leaRning), a novel active learning framework designed specifically for abstractive summarization. translated_title: 基于损失的主动学习用于神经抽象摘要生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25881v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：微调抽象摘要生成模型需要高质量的标注数据。然而，获取此类语料库成本高昂且耗时，因为需要人工标注者阅读和理解长文档以生成准确的摘要。主动学习通过仅选择最具信息量的实例进行标注来缓解这一问题，使模型能够在显著减少标签的情况下达到竞争性结果。然而，主动学习在摘要生成中的应用仍未被充分探索，现有研究常常面临不稳定性和显著的计算瓶颈。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了LOBSTER（基于损失的主动学习），一种专门为抽象摘要生成设计的新型主动学习框架。LOBSTER通过优先选择与模型当前高损失训练示例语义相似的无标签实例来提高性能，使模型能够显式地纠正其弱点。
tldr: 本文提出LOBSTER框架，通过选择与模型高损失训练示例语义相似的未标注实例进行主动学习，从而在减少标注成本的同时提升抽象摘要生成模型的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the LOBSTER framework, which improves abstractive summarization model performance with fewer labels by actively selecting unlabeled instances semantically similar to the model's current high-loss training examples.
